headline: DeepSeek releases open-weight V4.1-Flash-1017 and makes search tools available
body: DeepSeek released Deepseek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as an open-weight model on Hugging Face and ModelScope. In DeepSeek's own benchmarks it scores 77.0 percent on DeepSWE at an average cost of just under $0.20 per task, against 74.2 percent at around $0.50 for its predecessor. The Decoder notes that independent benchmarks haven't come out yet. DeepSeek is also making Search and Fetch APIs available to developers at $0.75 per 1,000 calls.
note: Vendor benchmarks are the only numbers so far, so a bank evaluating open-weight agent models would wait for independent tests. The price per task is the figure to watch for high-volume back-office agents.

evidence.text: Deepseek also published the model weights as open source on Hugging Face and ModelScope .
V4.1-Flash-1017 hits a top score of 77.0 percent at an average cost of just under $0.20 per task.
The predecessor scored 74.2 percent but cost around $0.50 per run.
In Deepseek's own benchmarks, V4.1-Flash-1017 outperforms its predecessor V4.1-Flash.
Independent benchmarks haven't come out yet, and benchmarks only tell half the story anyway.
A cost chart for the DeepSWE benchmark shows how much the shorter outputs matter for efficiency.
Alongside the language model, Deepseek is making its web search tools (Search & Fetch APIs) available to all developers.
